TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd will field a cross-functional delivery team spanning solution architecture, data-centre/network implementation, commissioning, documentation, and warranty support, backed by 250 staff and delivery offices in Islamabad (HQ), Lahore, and Karachi for multi-site execution across PITB’s six regional offices [CO-PROFILE]. Project governance will be led by PMP-certified project managers (6 in-house) using controlled scope, schedule, risk and change management aligned to PITB’s requirement for structured knowledge transfer and predictable commissioning [CO-PROFILE].

Certifications and compliance are aligned to PITB’s mandatory requirements: we hold ISO 27001 for information security management and ISO 9001 for quality management [CO-PROFILE]. Our delivery maturity is further evidenced by CMMI Level 3 capability [CO-PROFILE], which we apply through standardized design reviews, configuration baselining, test plans, and acceptance sign-offs—particularly important for high-availability designs with no single point of failure.

Relevant enterprise network/data-centre experience above the PKR 30M threshold within the last five years includes Network Design deployments valued at PKR 44M (completed 2025) and PKR 182M (completed 2022) [CAP-021][CAP-009], as well as PKR 133M (completed 2020) [CAP-033].

For statutory and commercial readiness, we are FBR registered with Active Taxpayer (ATL) status [CO-PROFILE], and can arrange bid security via CDR/bank guarantee from scheduled banks within our facility limit [CO-PROFILE].

OEM engineer certifications and single-OEM partner/reseller authorization are not yet evidenced in our library; we will address this by confirming the selected OEM’s authorised partner pathway and assigning OEM-certified engineers (or OEM-certified subcontract resources) prior to mobilisation. Our support model is an in-country support desk with 24–48h response SLAs [CO-PROFILE]; PITB’s requested 24x7 helpdesk and four-hour on-site response for critical incidents will be formalised in the project-specific SLA and staffing plan.
